entities.label: Cost events
entities.description: Metered service usage and estimated cost ledger.
entities.warning: Deleting events changes global cost totals and cannot be undone.

entities.label: Cost migration state
entities.description: Completed cost-ledger backfills and their imported event counts.
entities.warning: Deleting this state can duplicate historical costs on the next restart.

entities.label: Task runs
entities.description: Scheduled, manual, startup, and catch-up execution history.
entities.warning: Deleting a run also deletes its stored log.

entities.label: Task run logs
entities.description: Captured log lines for completed task runs.

entities.label: Task schedule state
entities.description: Last evaluated cron occurrence used for catch-up decisions.
entities.warning: Deleting state changes the catch-up baseline for that task.

entities.label: Streamer status
entities.description: Current aggregate live session and last offline state per streamer.
entities.warning: Deleting live state can cause a fresh went-live transition on the next check.

entities.label: Stream sessions
entities.description: Completed live sessions per streamer (start, end, peak, title).
entities.warning: Deleted session history cannot be reconstructed.

entities.label: Viewer metrics
entities.description: Daily viewer peaks and all-time records per streamer.
entities.warning: Deleted viewer records cannot be reconstructed outside the retained window.

entities.label: Streamer platform viewer metrics
entities.description: Per-platform daily viewer peaks for grouped streamer identities.

entities.label: Livestream profile identity links
entities.description: Durable direct-profile associations between platform accounts.

entities.label: Livestream intelligence
entities.description: Current semantic metadata, summaries, chapters, and alert state.

entities.label: Livestream alert feedback
entities.description: Useful, not-useful, and false-positive alert corrections.

entities.label: Livestream diagnostics
entities.description: Latest metadata, voice, summary, and alert pipeline status per streamer.

entities.label: Livestream intelligence events
entities.description: Bounded timeline of meaningful livestream intelligence decisions and failures.

entities.label: Media recommendations
entities.description: Recommendation attempts, delivery state, outcomes, and feedback.
entities.warning: Deleting rows changes cooldown, exclusion, and taste evidence behavior.

entities.label: Podcast recommendations
entities.description: Podcast episode picks, queue state, outcomes, and feedback.
entities.warning: Deleting rows changes episode exclusions and show cooldowns.

entities.label: Podcast taste evidence
entities.description: Listen, outcome, and feedback observations for podcast reflection.
entities.warning: Deleting evidence changes the inputs available to future reflections.

entities.label: Podcast taste profiles
entities.description: Generated checkpoints of the current podcast taste model.

entities.label: Taste evidence
entities.description: Versioned observations used to build the media taste profile.
entities.warning: Deleting evidence changes the inputs available to future reflections.

entities.label: Taste profiles
entities.description: Generated checkpoints of the current media taste model.

entities.label: Identity aliases
entities.description: Cached Plex GUID to TMDB identity resolutions.
entities.warning: Deleted aliases will be resolved again when encountered.

entities.label: Briefing history
entities.description: Recent notifications retained for briefing deduplication.
entities.warning: Deleting history can allow a briefing to repeat prior stories.

entities.label: PressPods episodes
entities.description: Generated podcast episodes: metadata, narration, chunk stats, costs.
entities.warning: Deleting a row does not remove its audio file from disk; the episode also drops out of the RSS feed.

entities.label: PressPods jobs
entities.description: Durable submission queue with retry backoff and stale-claim reclaim.

entities.label: Submitted deliveries
entities.description: Parcel tracking numbers already sent to Parcel.app.
entities.warning: This is a deduplication gate. Deleted rows may be submitted again.

entities.label: Created calendar events
entities.description: Calendar events created from email, keyed by normalized content.
entities.warning: This is a deduplication gate. Deleted rows may create duplicate events.

entities.label: Email activity
entities.description: Per-email outcomes from the parcel and calendar pipelines.

entities.label: Email activity logs
entities.description: Captured log lines for emails that reached pipeline processing.

entities.label: Email IMAP cursors
entities.description: Per-folder iCloud IMAP UID cursors for incremental email processing.
entities.warning: Deleting a cursor can replay old email through every email handler.

entities.label: Email dispatch state
entities.description: Last email dispatch timestamp, used by the pipeline watchdog.

entities.label: Email retries
entities.description: Emails queued for reprocessing after transient failures.

entities.label: Email sender rules
entities.description: User-defined block/allow rules merged into the email filters.

entities.label: Email feedback
entities.description: Explicit outcome corrections injected into email triage prompts.

entities.label: Workspace subjects
entities.description: Durable dossiers maintained inside Omni workspaces.

entities.label: Workspace artifact revisions
entities.description: Append-only history of workspace briefs, research, and decisions.

entities.label: Workspace messages
entities.description: User and agent conversation attached to workspace subjects.

entities.label: Workspace sources
entities.description: Web and explicitly scoped email evidence used by workspaces.

entities.label: Workspace actions
entities.description: Deterministic side effects awaiting or recording human approval.

entities.label: Workspace email scopes
entities.description: Explicitly approved senders and keywords eligible for ingestion.

entities.label: Workspace papercuts
entities.description: Deduplicated capability and workflow problems reported by agents.

entities.label: Workspace notifications
entities.description: Durable Pushover delivery outbox with retry state.
